summary: xAI launched a built-in plugin marketplace for Grok Build that bundles skills, slash commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers and LSPs from partners like MongoDB, Vercel, Sentry, Chrome DevTools and Cloudflare, installable via the CLI.

practices.reason: Teams using Grok Build now have a new package/install surface and security model (commit-pinned plugins) to integrate and verify.
practices.quote: Every remote plugin in the catalog is pinned to a specific commit SHA, and Grok Build verifies the pin at install time.

practices.reason: Plugins package agents, hooks, MCP servers and LSPs into installable units, a packaging convenience rather than a described technique with a stated gain.
practices.quote: A plugin bundles skills , slash commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers, and LSPs into one installable package.
